course.title: Urban Planning Principles
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A Speciality steel manufacturer produces two types of steel g1 and g2. Type 1 requires (20) 2 hours of melting, 4 hours of rolling and 10 hours of cutting. Type 2 requires 5 hours of melting, 1 hours of rolling and 5 hours of cutting. 40 hours are available for melting, 20 for rolling and 60 for cutting. The profit margin for type 1 is 24; for type 2 it is 8. Reduce the data to the equations and inequalities necessary to determine the output mix that will maximize profits.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
